description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractDittoGraphStageLogic' extending Akka Streams' GraphStageLogicWithLogging, adding Ditto-specific stream processing functions, notably 'passAlongMapConcat' for passing and transforming stream elements.

classes.name: AbstractDittoGraphStageLogic
classes.description: An extension of Akka's GraphStageLogicWithLogging with additional Ditto-specific stream processing methods.

classes.name: PassAlongMapConcatHandler
classes.description: A private inner class handling the passing and mapping of stream elements from an inlet to an outlet.

methods.name: passAlongMapConcat
methods.description: A method to pass elements from an inlet to an outlet after applying a mapping function that can produce multiple output elements.
